candidate_eligibility_rule: an establishment is an operational candidate for planning_date P if Component 2 resolved its identity and it has at least one real inspection record with inspection_date < P. Zero prior records means the establishment has not been observed to exist as of P, and is excluded -- not because it is judged safe or unsafe, but because nothing about it is knowable as of the boundary this component enforces.
